title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1
content:
Meeting: prep for 1:1 with Alex (Head of Product) + follow-up action items
Date: Thurs 2026-03-05 (sync) — quick 30m
Goal: align on SOC2 / ISO readiness priorities, vendor risk decisions, and what product needs to provide for evidence and timelines.

Top objectives (what I need from Alex):
- Confirm priority list for controls that touch product telemetry and data flows (encryption at rest/in transit, access controls on logs, PII masking).
- Get buy-in for delivering small audit-friendly artifacts: data flow diagrams, threat model update, and a short narrative for each control owner.
- Decision on vendor attestations (which vendors need SOC2/ISO cert proof vs compensating controls).
- Commitment on a timeline for delivering requested IR/incident response runbook updates.

Agenda (30m):
1) 0-5m: quick status (where we are vs SOC2 readiness checklist)
2) 5-15m: controls with product impact (items requiring product work) — discuss owners and rough ETA
3) 15-25m: vendor risk + procurement ask (which vendors to prioritize for evidence)
4) 25-30m: action items + next checkpoint (owners + dates)

Current status summary (notes to self):
- Controls mapped: 78% mapped across teams, still missing evidence for 9 controls mostly in change management and logging retention.
- Evidence gaps flagged:
  * CM-2 change approval logs (we have PRs but no signed change windows doc)
  * LOG-5 centralized log retention policy (product needs to confirm retention window and exportability)
  * VENDOR-3 supplier SOC2 reports (we have certs for infra providers, missing for a couple ML infra vendors)
- Internal audit wants machine-readable proof where possible (timestamps, config snapshots). Need to push product for export endpoints or scheduled dumps.

Key questions to ask Alex:
- Can we get a single product engineer assigned as 'evidence liaison' for the next 6 weeks to collect config snapshots and dataflow diagrams? (suggest: Devon)
- Will product sign off on adding a small export endpoint for log retention metadata (format: csv/json) for auditors?
- Are there upcoming infra changes (deploy windows) that will impact collection of baseline configs? Need freeze dates.

Vendor risk quick notes:
- ML model hosting vendor (Vendor X) — status: no SOC2 in scope; vendor claims ISO27001 but no recent audit report. Request: legal to escalate for attestation or require compensating controls (e.g., encryption at rest, restricted key access).
- Observability provider (Vendor Y) — SOC2 Type II available (latest report 2025), ok. Need to store report link in vendor register.
- Data labeling vendor (Vendor Z) — no attestation, high sensitivity (PII possible). Recommend: move labeling in-house or require contract clause + periodic manual review.

Draft asks for Product (to raise in meeting):
- Assign evidence liaison + weekly 15m catch-up with security (owner, start date)
- Provide final dataflow diagrams for the following services by 2026-03-20: auth, inference pipeline, logging pipeline
- Confirm retention policy for logs (prod and staging) by 2026-03-17 and provide export endpoint or manual export process
- Provide config snapshot for deployment infra (k8s manifests, key rotation status) for baseline date 2026-03-01

Action items (pre-meeting prep for me):
- Pull updated controls mapping from Confluence and highlight product-impact controls (due 2026-03-04) — DONE (draft attached)
- Compile list of vendors lacking attestations + proposed compensating controls (due 2026-03-04) — draft in notes below
- Prepare short 1-pager for Alex showing what product deliverables look like for auditors (template) (due 2026-03-04)

Post-meeting follow-ups (expected):
- Owner: Devon Patel — collate config snapshots + evidence folder for CM-2 and LOG-5 (due 2026-03-18)
- Owner: Sara Kim (GTM/legal liaison) — escalate Vendor X for attestation or contract clause (due 2026-03-15)
- Owner: Luis Ortega (SRE) — implement scheduled export for log retention metadata (or define manual process) (due 2026-03-17)
- Owner: Alex (Product) — confirm product engineer assignment and sign-off on export endpoint (due 2026-03-10)

Evidence checklist (notes):
- Dataflow diagrams (pdf + source) — must show auth boundaries, PII stores, ingress/egress for 3p vendors
- Config snapshots (k8s manifests, secrets rotation timestamps, kms key IDs, IAM policies) — prefer hashed/timestamped exports
- Logs: retention policy doc + sample export (covering 90 days for prod, 30 for staging)
- Vendor attestations: SOC2/ISO cert pdfs or signed compensating control narrative
- Change management logs: PRs + deployment window approvals + rollback runbook

Risks to surface during meeting:
- If Vendor X cannot produce an attestation in time, we may need to enforce mitigations that impact time-to-market for feature X (risk: product pushback).
- Lack of a single evidence liaison will slow collection and increase audit prep cost.
- Some older services (pre-2023) lack exportable config snapshots — may need manual evidence collection and engineering time.

Notes / talking points (short):
- We are aiming for SOC2 Type II readiness for core product lines by end of Q2; ISO alignment tracked in parallel but resource-limited.
- Emphasize small, product-friendly asks: one engineer liaison, export endpoints for metadata, and clear retention policy commit.
- Offer security team to draft the actual export scripts or small PRs if product assigns an engineer to review and merge.

Reference links (for quick share in meeting):
- Controls mapping: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SOC2+Controls+Mapping
- Vendor register: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Vendor+Risk+Register
- Audit cadence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Audit+Calendar

Scratchpad (raw bullets I might say):
- "We don't need full infra overhaul — want small artifacts that auditors can validate. If product gives us exports, security will weave into evidence bundle."
- "Vendor X: if no attestation, require contract + restrict data access + rotate keys more frequently."
- "Prefer timeline: evidence collated by 2026-03-20 so internal audit can run a dry-run the week of 2026-03-22."

TODO (personal):
- Print 1-pager and send calendar invite with agenda to Alex + Devon + Luis + Sara (by EOD 2026-03-04).
- Update Confluence controls page with the new owner assignments after meeting.

End of notes.
